author: npew
text:
OpenAI is a great place for anyone who loves building product.

2025 so far: o3-mini, Deep Research, Operator, GPT-4.1, ImageGen, GPT-5, Codex, Pulse, Sora 2, AgentKit, and now Atlas. (probably missed a few!)

author: npew
text: Another milestone reached in the pursuit of AGI: gold medal performance on the IMO.

quoted.text: 1/N I’m excited to share that our latest @OpenAI experimental reasoning LLM has achieved a longstanding grand challenge in AI: gold medal-level performance on the world’s most prestigious math competition—the International Math Olympiad (IMO). https://t.co/SG3k6EknaC
